_comment: Maps sessionKey substrings to allowed scope lists. First matching entry wins. Edit here (no code change needed) to add/remove family members or change access patterns. 'scopes' values must be subset of ['private','family','public']. When extending to new channels (signal, email, etc.), use same substring style: ':<channel>:direct:<id>'.
_security_warning: CRITICAL: Never use broad channel-only patterns like ':discord:' or ':whatsapp:' for private/family scopes — they match EVERY session on that channel (including strangers in group chats). Always use exact identity patterns: ':discord:user:<USER_ID>' or ':discord:channel:<CHANNEL_ID>' for Discord, ':whatsapp:direct:<PHONE_NUMBER>' for WhatsApp. See OpenClaw session key documentation.
